projectDescription: A space-themed personal portfolio site for a senior systems engineer, featuring animated components for showcasing projects, skills, work history, case studies, articles, and contact information.
keyFeatures: Animated starfield and aurora ribbon background effects
Interactive constellation map for showcasing projects
Spectrum analyzer visualization for technical skills
Orbital path component for work history timeline
Radio dial contact interface with multiple communication channels
Star map index for browsable articles
Case study reader with darkroom film-strip aesthetic
Cursor trail and page transition animations
publicApiSurface: ConstellationLayout — interactive star map of projects
SpectrumAnalyzer — bar chart visualization of skill frequencies
OrbitalPath — elliptical timeline of work history
RadioDial — contact channel selector with dial UI
Navigation — fixed header with aurora indicator
